svg.title: GC-MoE Decode Speedup Curves on 8xH20 and 8xB300, Dual-Architecture Paths, and Audit Boundaries
svg.desc: Top-left plots measured decode speedup across 1 to 256 tokens per rank for H20 and B300 models; top-right contrasts Blackwell SM103 and Hopper SM90 GEMM implementations; bottom-left summarizes effective TFLOPS, analytic bandwidth models, and 376/752 numerical parity checks; bottom-right highlights four explicit scientific and shape boundaries.
